propositions: when a Jira parent is removed the local parent_id is never cleared because fetcher omits absent parents from snapshots and inbound_differ refuses to emit parent_id=None

an unconditional clear without peer evidence destroys parent edges: 63 tickets were de-parented by clearing a local parent rebar never confirmed Jira had, because managed_refs only proves local creation not peer presence

the differ's same-pass suppression against concurrent outbound writes cannot fire because the parent emit gate is disjoint (epic-only outbound vs sub-task-only inbound on DC, or non-epic-only on Cloud)
the fix requires positive evidence that the peer once carried this parent via ADR-0026 baseline advancement, gated on observed parent key presence to prevent fail-open reads from overwriting history
the apply layer is ready to handle parent_id=None but intermediate layers were dropping it silently before it arrived
